item.text:
**7B.3 Research Note: Joko Widodo, 2024**

Overall read: **mixed but leaning negative**. There is solid evidence that Jokowi sometimes respected formal limits and allowed technocratic institutions to operate. But the stronger 2024 pattern is **family-advantage politics and patronage**: election-rule maneuvering that would have benefited his son, attempts to preserve influence through party control, and cabinet appointments that smoothed the transition via loyalists. Direct evidence of personal business enrichment is thinner than evidence of **dynastic / network capture**.

**Positive / separating interests**
- **Farewell-Welcome Ceremony for Indonesia’s President from Jokowi to Prabowo Subianto**. Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia. 2024-10-20. [URL](https://setkab.go.id/en/farewell-welcome-ceremony-for-indonesias-president-from-jokowi-to-prabowo-subianto/) | Jokowi formally welcomed Prabowo after inauguration, showing he completed the constitutional handover rather than clinging to office. **QIDs:** 7B.3, 4B.2
- **Indonesia court rejects election challenges, upholds Prabowo’s win**. Reuters via ThePrint. 2024-04-22. [URL](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-challenges-upholds-president-elect-prabowos-win/2051390/) | The court said there was no evidence of systematic fraud or presidential meddling, which is limited positive evidence that formal institutions were still allowed to stand. **QIDs:** 7B.3, 4B.2
- **I never asked for a third term as president: Jokowi**. The Jakarta Post. 2024-12-30. [URL](https://www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/2024/12/30/i-never-asked-for-a-third-term-as-president-jokowi.html) | Jokowi denied seeking a third term, which is a direct statement against overt personal entrenchment beyond the legal limit. **QIDs:** 7B.3, 4B.2
- **IMF staff completes 2024 Article IV mission to Indonesia**. IMF. 2024-06-14. [URL](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/14/pr24221-imf-staff-completes-2024-article-iv-mission-to-indonesia) | IMF described prudent, credible fiscal/monetary frameworks, suggesting at least some core economic policy remained technocratic rather than obviously personal or familial. **QIDs:** 7B.3

**Negative / overlapping interests**
- **Indonesia leader accused of bias, interference in presidential election**. Reuters via ThePrint. 2024-02-01. [URL](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-leader-accused-of-bias-interference-in-presidential-election/1948656/) | Reuters reported criticism of Jokowi’s apparent non-neutrality and visible alignment with Prabowo while his son was on the ticket, indicating use of incumbency to shape the succession field. **QIDs:** 7B.3, 4B.2
- **Jokowi seeks Golkar takeover to retain decade-long influence**. Reuters via The Jakarta Post. 2024-03-20. [URL](https://www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/2024/03/20/jokowi-seeks-golkar-takeover-to-retain-decade-long-influence) | Reuters reported he was trying to install an ally atop Golkar and secure an advisory role, which reads as post-office influence preservation through party capture. **QIDs:** 7B.3, 4B.2
- **Indonesia’s outgoing leader gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo**. Reuters via Investing.com. 2024-08-19. [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/outgoing-indonesian-president-widodo-names-prabowo-aides-to-cabinet-3576652) | Jokowi appointed people close to Prabowo into cabinet roles to smooth the transition, which is classic patronage/network management rather than neutral state staffing. **QIDs:** 7B.3
- **Protests across Indonesia as parliament delays change to election law**. Reuters via ThePrint. 2024-08-22. [URL](https://theprint.in/world/protests-across-indonesia-as-parliament-delays-change-to-election-law/2233305/) | The proposed rule changes would have helped Jokowi’s youngest son and blocked a critic; the reporting and protests frame this as constitutional insubordination and family-advantage rule bending. **QIDs:** 7B.3, 4B.2
- **World Bank Group Debars PT. LPPSLH Konsultan**. World Bank. 2024-07-10. [URL](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/10/world-bank-group-debars-pt-lppslh-konsultan) | The World Bank said a project in Jokowi-era stunting reduction work involved overbilling and the improper hiring of a project official’s family member. This does not prove Jokowi personally ordered it, but it is direct evidence that family-linked favoritism persisted inside a state-funded project. **QIDs:** 7B.3, 8B.4
- **Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says Jokowi left patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity**. Reuters via ThePrint. 2024-10-14. [URL](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) | Reuters’ year-end framing is broad, but it strongly supports the inference that personal/family political interests were not cleanly separated from the state. **QIDs:** 7B.3, 4B.2, 4B.6

**Search gap**
- I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Jokowi personally had a private business interest directly steering state procurement, licensing, or regulation.
- The best-supported negative pattern is **family/succession advantage and patronage**, not a clearly documented personal business empire driving state decisions.
- Foreign policy evidence in 2024 looked mostly state-centered and diplomatic; I did not find a reliable case showing foreign policy being used for personal or family commercial gain.

If you want, I can turn this into the same compact claim-index format as the prior lens.
